acceptanceCriteria: A replayed renew/heartbeat/claim result whose generation is superseded carries an advisory warning naming the current generation, while the replayed result body stays byte-identical (CAL-V0-048 replay contract test unchanged).
A test covers release + re-claim + replay of the old request ID, and one mutation removes the warning.
body: Residual from the V1-1313/1320/1321 tasks claim/renew lane (PR #915, branch claude/tasks-claim-renew-1321-1313-1320, head e6f5e9208, base 595359a1b). V1-1320 was refuted: a superseded-generation renew/heartbeat with a fresh request ID is refused FENCED (CAL-V0-230). The reported 'OK' most likely came from reusing an earlier request ID, which replays the original result as TCP-00 / CAL-V0-048 require. An operator reading that replay cannot tell the lease has since moved on. Idea: add a non-authoritative advisory warning on a replayed result when the attempt's current generation differs from the replayed one, leaving the replayed payload byte-identical.
title: corvint-tasks: warn when an idempotent replay returns OK for a generation that is now superseded
